title: Form fields and submission
procedure: Blank username/password, each field completed separately, then a test account. 1 Submit with missing fields. 2 Show and hide the password. 3 Complete both fields and press Enter.
expected: Identify missing fields and focus the first invalid field. Visibility controls preserve the value. Enter submits once. Feedback must not expose the password.
r1_actual: Empty submit: "กรุณากรอกชื่อผู้ใช้และรหัสผ่าน", focus on username; missing password: focus on password. Show/hide toggles type text/password and keeps the value. Wrong password: "ชื่อผู้ใช้หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง" (password not shown). Enter with valid account sent 1 request and signed in.
r1_evidence: Headless Chrome 156, test stack :5174/:8081. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Actual Staff authentication
procedure: A valid Staff account, an invalid account and an incorrect password. 1 Test invalid credentials separately. 2 Sign in correctly. 3 Verify the returned name and role.
expected: The actual service rejects invalid credentials and grants the correct Staff access and identity. A demonstration login alone does not satisfy this case.
r1_actual: Unknown user -> 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; wrong password -> 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (same answer, no hint which part was wrong). Valid login -> 200; /auth/me returns Somsri Rattanakul with role operator. Access log recorded: nobody-here:failed,somsri:failed,somsri:success.
r1_evidence: API /auth/login, /auth/me; access_logs rows. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Sign Out and protected pages
procedure: An authenticated Staff session with no draft. 1 Sign out. 2 Use Back or open a protected page. 3 Reload and request the service without a session.
expected: Return to login. Protect private data and operations at both interface and service levels. Stored local state must not restore unauthorized access.
r1_actual: Sign Out returns to login; Back and reload stay on login; service without a session answers 401. Observation: an old session cookie copied before sign-out still answers 200 until it expires (stateless cookie, known gap in backend/README.md).
r1_evidence: Observation: stateless session cookie stays valid until expiry after sign-out (known gap). Known gap: no server-side session revocation. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Sign Out after a Check-In session
procedure: Two Parcels saved in the Check-In dialog and a third code typed but not saved. 1 Confirm Sign Out cannot be reached while the dialog is open. 2 Close the dialog. 3 Sign Out and sign in again.
expected: The two saved Parcels exist as Pending and the unsaved third code was never recorded. Sign Out needs no discard confirmation because nothing is held unsaved. No partial or empty record is created.
r1_actual: Saved N01, N02; typed N03. Sign Out could not be used while the dialog was open (dialog stayed open). After closing and signing out/in: N01=1, N02=1 records (Pending), N03=0 (never recorded). No discard prompt needed.
r1_evidence: Codes TP69-T04-N01..N03 (equivalent data) Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Navigation and current page
procedure: Staff access to Dashboard and Archive. 1 Switch between both menus. 2 Check the active menu. 3 Use the skip-to-content link and Check-In/Check-Out controls.
expected: Display the selected page and appropriate operation. Navigation must not change data. Keyboard users can reach the main content.
r1_actual: Dashboard/Archive switch shows the selected page and marks the active menu (aria-current=page). First Tab reaches "ข้ามไปยังเนื้อหา", Enter jumps to #main-content; Check-In and Check-Out buttons are reachable by Tab. Data unchanged by navigation.
r1_evidence: Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Directory-based Room Number validation
procedure: Room A: 090; Room B: 101/2; nonexistent room: 999. 1 Select A and B. 2 Verify Resident names. 3 Attempt Check-In with 999, with a blank room, and with a blank room after ticking the problem box.
expected: Preserve leading zeros and slashes. Names match the directory. A room can only be chosen from the directory list, and the service rejects an unknown room. A blank room is accepted only when the Parcel is marked as a problem; it is then saved without a room into the problem section (TC25).
r1_actual: Room A shows "1090 · ทดสอบ เอ", B shows "1101/2 · ทดสอบ บี" (leading zero and slash kept, names match). Unknown room gives no option and Save stays disabled; service rejects room id 999999 (422 ROOM_NOT_IN_DIRECTORY) and a blank room (400). Blank room with the problem box ticked is saved without a room (null,other).
r1_evidence: Room numbers stored as 090 and 101/2 in building 1 (labels 1090, 1101/2) Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Continuous scanning with the physical device
procedure: Ten supported labels N01-N10 and Room A. 1 Scan a label (the scanner sends Enter). 2 Select Room A and Save. 3 Repeat for all ten labels.
expected: Each code matches its label, without omissions, truncation or duplication. After each Save, focus returns to the Tracking Code field with the code and room cleared, and the Parcel appears in the session list. Exactly ten records exist, all in Room A.
r1_actual: No physical scanner was available in this run. Typed input does not establish a scanner result (Section 3), so ten-label continuous scanning was not executed.
r1_evidence: Needs the project scanner and labels N01-N10. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Scan order and focus
procedure: The Check-In dialog just opened, a valid Room A, and a code scanned while Room Number is blank. 1 Scan a code. 2 Inspect where focus moves. 3 Select Room A and Save.
expected: The Tracking Code field is focused when the dialog opens. Enter after a scan moves focus to Room Number and does not save. Save stays disabled until a room is chosen (or the Parcel is marked as a problem). The code is never stored as a Room Number.
r1_actual: Keyboard emulation only: code field focused on open; Enter after the code moved focus to Room Number without saving; Save disabled until a room was chosen; saved to room A correctly. Physical scanner not available, so the case cannot pass yet.
r1_evidence: Rerun with the project scanner. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Unreadable labels and manual fallback

expected: Do not guess codes or create incorrect records. Manual entry remains available. Scanning resumes after reconnection. Record the input method used.
r1_actual: No physical scanner or deteriorated label available; disconnect/reconnect could not be tested. Manual typing of a verified code works (see TC10/TC12).
r1_evidence: Needs the project scanner. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Tracking Code boundaries
procedure: Blank and whitespace-only values, lengths 64 and 65, an inner space, Thai characters, control characters, lower case and leading/trailing spaces. 1 Submit each dataset separately. 2 Inspect the form and saved data.
expected: Accept 1-64 printable ASCII characters. Reject blanks, 65-character values, inner spaces, Thai and control characters. Trim surrounding spaces and store the code in upper case without truncating it. The service applies the same rule whatever the interface sends.
r1_actual: Service: blank, spaces-only, 65 chars, inner space, Thai and tab are rejected (400); 64 chars accepted and stored whole; "t10-lower" stored as T10-LOWER; "  T10-PAD  " stored as T10-PAD. Interface: a 65-character code shows "ข้อมูลไม่ถูกต้อง กรุณาตรวจสอบและลองใหม่" and is not saved.
r1_evidence: Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

r1_evidence: DF-01 (Medium): problem queue listed newest first; US-06 requires oldest first. Defect: problem queue sorted newest first (UnmatchedQueue uses the default list order); US-06 requires oldest first. Run 28 Oct 2026, build 4782b57, isolated test database.

title: Archive filters and counts

title: Peak-volume load (Flash Sale)
procedure: A test database seeded with about 30 days of history at peak volume, and a load script replaying one Flash Sale day: 1,024 Check-Ins and 1,024 Check-Outs, including a courier burst of 200 Check-Ins in 10 minutes, while three Staff sessions search and page the Dashboard. 1 Run the script in the test environment. 2 Record response times and errors per operation. 3 Inspect the query plans of room and Tracking Code lookups.
expected: No errors, timeouts, lost or duplicated records; final counts match the script. 95th-percentile response time is under 2 seconds for Check-In (US-01) and under 1 second for search and room lookup (US-05). Lists stay paginated, lookups use the room and Tracking Code indexes, and notifications are queued without slowing Check-In.
r1_actual: Database with 31024 Parcels. One Flash Sale day compressed into 9 s: 1,024 Check-Ins (first 200 as a courier burst for five rooms in 1 s, 10 desks in parallel) and 1,024 Check-Outs, with three Staff sessions searching and paging throughout. check-in n=1024 p50 26 ms, p95 47 ms, max 199 ms, errors 0; check-out n=1024 p50 23 ms, p95 41 ms, max 180 ms, errors 0; search n=272 p50 71 ms, p95 126 ms, max 171 ms, errors 0; room lookup n=51 p50 14 ms, p95 34 ms, max 91 ms, errors 0; dashboard page n=112 p50 22 ms, p95 39 ms, max 71 ms, errors 0; summary n=76 p50 34 ms, p95 61 ms, max 90 ms, errors 0. Records: 1024 created, 1024 unique, 1024 Picked Up; events 1024 Check-In / 1024 Check-Out — none lost or duplicated. 7 notification rows queued without failing any Check-In. Query plans: Tracking Code → Index Scan using parcels_tracking_code_prefix_idx on parcels / Index Cond: (tracking_code = 'LOAD-MVS6NXT4-0001'::text); room Pending → Bitmap Heap Scan on parcels / ->  Bitmap Index Scan on parcels_room_status_idx / Index Cond: ((room_id = 1) AND (status = 'pending'::parcel_status)); code prefix → Index Scan using parcels_tracking_code_prefix_idx on parcels / Index Cond: ((tracking_code ~>=~ 'LOAD-MVS6NXT4-00'::text) AND (tracking_code ~<~ 'LOAD-MVS6NXT4-01'::text)).
